pages.en:
I climb the stairs.

I left Saber to watch the house and came to school, but the clouds inside my head have yet to clear.

I go up the stairs.
Leaving Saber to watch the house, I end up at school, but I’m still a little gloomy.

pages.en:
“…E-Emiya!?”

“—Ah.”

—There she is.

The impossibly convenient person I can consult about anything is coming down the hall with jaunty little steps.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Emiya-kun!?”
“Oh.”
She’s here.
The one person I can discuss anything with appears out of nowhere. It’s almost too good to be true.

“—I see.

“You’re underestimating me. Is that it?”

Apparently she has something to discuss with me as well, because she stops and speaks first.

What extraordinary luck. Talk about a timely rescue!

In that case—
